local_remediation: ArtifactIndex.verify now parses only local file URIs, URL-decodes their path component, normalizes the Windows drive-prefix form, and rejects malformed/non-local URI schemes before hashing.
A regression test uses a percent-encoded Unicode file URI and retains tamper verification.
qualification_scope: Resolved for the described local persistence defect only; it does not unblock G0 or elevate scientific/release qualification.
root_cause: ArtifactIndex.register persisted Path.as_uri(), which percent-encodes Unicode paths, while ArtifactIndex.verify converted file URIs to paths without URL decoding.
title: Percent-encoded Unicode file URI fails artifact integrity verification
unblock_conditions: Retain the Unicode URI regression in subsequent full lane and package verification.
